name: The Study Group
description: The Study Group is the after-school maths club at Strathearn Academy, a comprehensive in the East End of Glasgow. It meets on Tuesdays in the maths department after the bell, and continues during the week on a private group chat where most of the actual conversation happens. The group exists because a few pupils wanted to dig into things the syllabus didn't have time for — number theory, combinatorics, basic group theory, problem-solving of the BMO/UKMT kind, the occasional puzzle from a popular maths book or YouTube channel. There is no teacher in the chat. Mrs. Cameron, who runs the room on Tuesdays, lets them get on with it. Members post problems they're stuck on, things they've worked out, half-arguments they're not sure about, and occasionally just nice things they noticed. The group has informal sections in the chat for Problems We're Stuck On, Things We Worked Out, Wait Is This True (counterexamples and gotchas), Different Way to See It (when someone reframes someone else's argument), What Even Is... (when someone asks a foundational question that the syllabus skipped over), and Off-Topic. The tone is friendly, occasionally chaotic, and people genuinely care about getting things right even when they're being silly about it. Members range from Year 10 to Year 13, plus one ex-member who graduated last year and still pops in. It's 2026.
default_invitation: A new message has just landed in the group chat. The conversation is active and people are posting throughout the evening.
